purpose: Teach: 帆/ニンニク/アダプタ/槍/ゴマ/えび/復刻/仮面ライダー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが帆船の絵を描いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is drawing a picture of a sailing ship right now.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Soft opening—noticing something to share. Warm but slightly distant, like she's watching from the kitchen. No urgency, just presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ニンニクの匂い大丈夫だよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm okay with the smell of garlic.
lines.style: Small, careful voice. Eager to prove something. Slightly urgent, like he's been thinking about this and needs to say it now. Open, trusting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古いアダプタを処分なさってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was throwing out some old adapters earlier.
lines.style: Same gentle observance as before—noticing domestic details. Warm but unhurried. A slight pause before 'old adapters,' like she's gathering the small facts of the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、博物館で槍と兜を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw spears and helmets at the museum today.
lines.style: Brighter now. Quick, excited delivery. He's been holding this in. Small leap forward in his voice—wanting her to understand how interesting this was. Genuine delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママは煎りゴマを朝ご飯に使うのよ
lines.en: Sho, Mommy uses roasted sesame seeds for breakfast.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact teaching voice. Sharing a small domestic truth. Gentle but steady—this is how things are done. Warm without reaching out.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お寿司屋さんでえびを食べたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat shrimp at the sushi restaurant.
lines.style: Direct, wanting. Light intensity—he knows what he wants and is telling her plainly. Not demanding, just clear. A small boy's honest appetite.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔のアニメの復刻版を買ってきたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought home a reissue of an old anime he used to watch.
lines.style: Same gentle, noticing quality. A touch of softness on 'old anime'—recognition of something from Dad's past. Sharing a moment between father and son. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、仮面ライダーの真似してみたよ
lines.en: Mom, I tried doing the Kamen Rider moves, look.
lines.style: Proud, showing off. Bright attack on 'Mom.' Quick, physical energy—he wants her to see what he can do. Small leap of pride in his voice. Genuine, unguarded.
